Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Medallion-Patterned Rug, 4' x 6', Red and Steel Blue
Materials: steel
This transitional rug boasts a multicolored pattern with a handstitched binding that adds elegance to any room. The soft, thick pile gives it a luxurious feel, great for tired feet. Durable nylon helps prevent wear and tear, keeping the rug looking beautiful. 4'W X 6'L Pile: 100% nylon; back: 100% cotton This durable nylon rug has a handstitched edging. A thick pile gives this rug a luxurious feel. Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
